title.en: Evolution of the Constitution: Two Birthdays, One Hall
title.hi: संविधान का विकास: दो जन्मदिन, एक कक्ष

sources.name: PIB backgrounder, Samvidhan Diwas 2024: Celebrating the spirit of Unity and Democracy, 25 November 2024
sources.what: Adoption on 26 November 1949; nearly three years of work; 389 members reduced to 299 after Partition; members from provinces, princely states and chief commissioner provinces; fifteen women; Constitution Day instituted 2015; original copies in helium-filled cases in the Parliament Library

sources.name: President of India press release, commemoration of 75 years of adoption of the Constitution, 26 November 2024
sources.what: Event in the Central Hall of Samvidhan Sadan; adoption in that hall 75 years earlier; nearly three years of deliberation and the freedom struggle; Preamble ideals; Samvidhan Divas every year since 2015; 75th anniversary of the Republic on 26 January 2025

sources.name: Constitution of India, Article 394 (Indian Kanoon)
sources.what: Articles 5 to 9, 60, 324, 366, 367, 379, 380, 388, 391 to 394 in force at once; rest on 26 January 1950, the commencement

q.en: On which date did the Constituent Assembly adopt the Constitution?
q.hi: संविधान सभा ने संविधान किस तारीख़ को अपनाया?

why.en: 26 November 1949 is adoption; 26 January 1950 is commencement.
why.hi: छब्बीस नवंबर उन्नीस सौ उनचास अंगीकरण है; छब्बीस जनवरी उन्नीस सौ पचास प्रारंभ है।

q.en: Which Article lists the provisions that came into force at once?
q.hi: कौन-सा अनुच्छेद तुरंत लागू होने वाले प्रावधानों की सूची देता है?

why.en: Article 394, Commencement, also names 26 January 1950 as the commencement.
why.hi: अनुच्छेद तीन सौ चौरानवे, प्रारंभ, छब्बीस जनवरी उन्नीस सौ पचास को प्रारंभ बताता है।

q.en: Since which year has 26 November been observed as Constitution Day?
q.hi: छब्बीस नवंबर को संविधान दिवस किस साल से मनाया जा रहा है?

why.en: PIB and the President's office date Samvidhan Divas from 2015.
why.hi: PIB और राष्ट्रपति कार्यालय संविधान दिवस की शुरुआत दो हज़ार पंद्रह से बताते हैं।

factsToCheck: Drafting Committee date (29 August 1947) and Dr B R Ambedkar as its chair were not opened in a primary source today; the script only says, per UPSC's official key for CSP 2023 Q85 as recorded in pyq.json, that 26 November 1949 was not the day the committee was set up
First sitting of the Assembly (9 December 1946) and the Objectives Resolution were left out: no source opened
Script glosses Articles 379 and 380 as provisional Parliament and provisional President, and Articles 5 to 9 as citizenship; Article 394 text lists only the numbers
notes: Recent example: 75th anniversary of adoption marked in the Central Hall of Samvidhan Sadan, 26 November 2024. Stays on the making; amendments are left to the Amendments episode.
